name: groundsocial-skills
description: Social media research skills on the Groundsocial API: brand mention scans, competitor social audits, creator vetting, subreddit research, TikTok trend scans, YouTube transcript research and comment mining, on public data from Reddit, X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and 70+ more platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Social media research on public data
interface.longDescription: Eight research skills on the Groundsocial API: scan brand mentions across Reddit, X, TikTok and YouTube, audit a competitor's social accounts, vet a creator before a sponsorship, research subreddits before posting, scan TikTok trends, research YouTube transcripts and mine comments for pain points. Everything is read-only public data. Calls go to the hosted Groundsocial MCP server or the REST API with your own key (100 free credits on signup).
capabilities: Find brand and product mentions across Reddit, X, TikTok and YouTube
Audit a competitor's posting and engagement on each platform
Rank subreddits for a topic with their rules and recurring questions
Pull and search YouTube transcripts and comments
defaultPrompt: Where is my product being mentioned on Reddit, X, TikTok and YouTube this week?
Which subreddits should I post my tool in, and what are their rules?
